name: Dendrite / Common Reverse

source.deck_back_baseline: existing v9 Dendrite; preserve until replacement passes tests

first_glance_intent: A living field of two-ness, separation, possible relation, and return before any one card is revealed.
recognition_evidence: At least two distinct relational influences that do not merge into a single seal
A perceivable interval or invitation between those influences
A return or recursive responsiveness that remains unfinished
A shared field capable of receiving different cards without preselecting an interpretation
causal_visual_mechanism: Derive an orientation-neutral undrawn-encounter field from the lexicon; vary distances, influences, shared pressure and return possibilities while preserving 180-degree visual parity; no individual card identity or affinity is revealed.
meaningful_space: The untaken-card field remains open anywhere; empty area must be intentional and may be central, peripheral, enclosed, interrupted or spanning edges.
misread_risk: A merged couple logo, infinity stamp, solitary static mascot, arbitrary mystic wallpaper, orientation cue, or a miniature face card without its name.
reversed_shadow_tension: Back has no upright/reversed reading and must not disclose orientation.
physical_card: 1400x2300 pixels, shared identical back for all 78 cards, 3.5x5.75 long tarot ratio
accessibility: Do not assume a nonvisual reader can infer the deck philosophy from the pattern; provide a concise accessible back description and deck overview.
test_prompts: What kind of encounter does this field invite, without suggesting any particular card?
Does any feature distinguish upright from reversed?
Is the visual field distinct from each face and meaningful without being a logo?
